_help: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EE] §EE (5 Oct). Villages: abandoned stone-and-timber towns relit hearth by hearth. Backlog reservoir, not a build list: prototype one archetype first. Siting weights are placeholders for Claude Code to tune.

siting._doc: Feng-shui logic as a suitability score over terrain the planet already computes.

archetypes.needs: clear mountain stream on a gentle slope
archetypes.notes: stone channels along every street, carp; water reused top to bottom
travel by small boat plus bridges and walkways; abandoned and still, not flooded
rooms cut into the cliff, cut stairs and ladders
buildings on top, rope bridges between, winch basket
houses in the branches, rope bridges
warm pools, steam, heat piped through houses
stilt grammar; bright, wistful when dead
same stilt grammar as the beach; witch huts; dread when dead

archetypes.needs: steep wet hillside with a stream

archetypes.notes: wind pumps, life below the waterline

specialties.dead_state: half-cut blocks, a chisel left in the rock

specialties.from: high point in sight of the next
specialties.dead_state: a cold brazier on a height

layout_rules._help: [NOT WIRED YET — design §EF] Applied in order after siting (§EE.3). Grow the village, then compose its views.

rules.do: seed at hearth/well/crossing/harbour; lay desire-line paths first; pack buildings along paths facing them, shared walls, dense core, loose edge

for each long straight sightline, ensure the far end lands on a focal point; else place one (well, lantern, feature tree, shrine, hearth house) or bend the street onto a building; distant landmarks count (borrowed scenery)
alternate narrow dark lanes with small open squares
buildings enclose courtyards and squares; no leftover open field inside the village
streets bend slightly for gradual reveals
low walls, steps, benches where light or view is good
key views get a near frame, middle subject, far backdrop
channels and streams run along streets, audible
gates, arches, paving changes between quarters
one spire, tower or great tree visible from most of the village

layout_rules.dead_village: cold hearths are placed at vista ends and in squares, so composition leads to the next fire
